items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: They called them. It's Cole, you know what? Miss Cole? Yeah. ... Yeah, we played there.

ctx.x: Did you play in many dance halls?
Oh, yeah. We played a whole lot in dance halls. But we played St. Elizabeth and St. Monica. We played at the dance hall. They called them. It's Cole, you know what? Miss Cole? Yeah.
